plugin.name: Wardrobe Executor (recommended)
plugin.description:
Installs HotkeyDeckWardrobe.esp plus two compiled Papyrus scripts.
This tiny ESP exists for one reason: some things can only be done from Papyrus. It hosts the script that talks to SOES-NG's outfit API, and a priority-90 quest whose reference aliases run vanilla-template packages so "freeze / sit / bed" survive a follower framework instead of being silently overridden.
Costs one plugin slot. Without it: - the Wardrobe tab's SOES handover is unavailable, - freeze / sit / bed fall back to actor-level holds and say so on screen.
Everything else in the mod works either way.

plugin.name: Skip it — keep the plugin slot free
plugin.description:
No ESP is installed. The core palette, Followers, Domains, Rooms, Finances, Quests, Loot, Containers, the Spell Deck and every other tab work normally.
You can install the ESP later by re-running this installer; the deck detects it at runtime and lights the affected controls back up.

plugin.name: Install the .psc sources too
plugin.description:
Ships the readable Papyrus source for the two scripts above, under Scripts\Source\. Useful if you want to recompile or patch them; pure clutter otherwise. The sources are already inside the Wardrobe Executor option, so this only matters if you skipped it.
(SkyManager is GPL-3.0 — the full C++ source lives in the repository linked on the mod page.)

plugin.name: Install Follower Organizer (recommended)
plugin.description:
Installs Follower Organizer, by MaskedRPGFan — the mod the Followers tab is built on — bundled here with their express permission, and with the two extra exported functions the tab needs.
It is not available anywhere else, so if you skip this the Followers tab has nothing to talk to and stays empty. Everything else works normally.
The plugin is ESL-flagged, so it costs no plugin slot. If you somehow already have Follower Organizer installed, let this overwrite it — the stock build has no Deck API.
Please credit and thank MaskedRPGFan, not me, for the mod itself. Report problems with it to SkyManager.

plugin.name: Skip it — no Followers tab
plugin.description: Leaves Follower Organizer out entirely. The Followers tab will report that it cannot find the Deck API and stay empty; every other tab is unaffected, and you can install it later by re-running this installer.

plugin.name: Install the Deck Portal
plugin.description:
Serves your follower roster, wardrobe, hotkeys and notes as a web page, so you can read and edit them from a phone or a second monitor while the game runs. Edits made while Skyrim is closed are queued and applied the next time the relevant tab opens in game.
REQUIRES NODE.JS (https://nodejs.org/en/download) — that is why it is optional and off by default. SkyManager itself needs nothing but SKSE and PrismaUI.
It listens on 127.0.0.1 only unless you deliberately widen it, and it refuses to start on a wider bind without a password. Do not port-forward it.
Installs to Data\SKSE\Plugins\HotkeyDeck\portal\ — see RUNBOOK.md in there.
